## 3. Go / no-go rules

- [ ] Supplier legal entity and bank payee are verified.
- [ ] Exact product provenance and authenticity are evidenced.
- [ ] Every SKU has a completed approval record.
- [ ] Product legality, MHRA status where required, packaging and duty status are verified.
- [ ] Supplier has signed the fulfilment, returns, recall and data terms.
- [ ] Payment provider has explicitly approved the exact product category and fulfilment model in writing.
- [ ] Total unit economics remain positive after VAT, product cost, dropship fee, delivery, payment processing, returns, chargebacks, age verification, recycling and customer support.
- [ ] Customer age verification and delivery controls are tested.
- [ ] Consumer terms, privacy, returns and WEEE take-back are live and accurate.
- [ ] End-to-end test orders, refunds, failed age checks and returns pass.

If any required item is missing, the decision is **HOLD**. Do not use optimistic assumptions to fill missing prices, compliance evidence or provider approval.
